[Sir](/person/712)
I was obliged to let your letter wait till my return as I could not reply without referring to the book.[^1]
‘The Second Temple’ is an anonymous poem in a collection called the Casket made by Joanna Baillie some 50 years ago
_______________________________________________________________________
Moses
[Cardinal Newman](/person/1084) - in the [Lyra Apostolica](/periodical/92)
_______________________________________________________________________
Seventh Sunday after Trinity-
Keble - [Lyra Innocentium](/periodical/232)
________________________________________________________________________
3d Sunday in Advent
[Mrs Yonge](/person/1606)
________________________________________________________________________
Good Friday
Come to a desert place
Wednesday in holy week
[Professor Anstice](/person/2285)
________________________________________________________________________
22d after Trinity
St John the Evangelist
Epiphany
Whitsunday
from Translations of hymns from the Paris Breviary by the Revd [Isaac Williams](/person/1523)
________________________________________________________________________

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Horder, who published several anthologies of hymns, had evidently asked CMY to identify the contributors to [The Child\'s Christian Year](/organisation/186), a volume compiled by her mother.
